candidateStateMachine.reviewReadyRule: local authority-green proof is necessary but not sufficient; the maintained public develop candidate head and maintained public wiki head must both be published and retained in docs/product/public-release-candidate.{md,json} before the next brand-new-fork review opens
candidateStateMachine.dirtyPublicSurfaceRule: preserve unrelated dirt, inspect overlapping changes, patch the maintained candidate slice narrowly, and pause only on direct unresolved conflicts instead of stopping candidate publication merely because the public source/wiki worktree is dirty

findingClassifications.summary: Authority develop had to be realigned to the exact released main line before the 1.2.0 feature branch could continue.
The next minor line adds one generic public GitHub/GitLab bootstrap command while keeping the canonical helper-backed icon-editor path separate.
Local authority-green proof had to stop being treated as reviewable truth before the maintained public candidate source and wiki heads were republished.
Brand-new-fork review exposed moved-VI compare pairs that still failed preflight on stale current-path blob reads even though VI History had followed the same VI across the rename.

notes: The repo-owned devcontainer blocker was retired by switching the Node base image surface to overrideCommand=true so postCreateCommand can complete.
The public devcontainer now completes npm ci, npm run compile, and npm run test:design-contract on the governed local machine surface.
The public VI History explorer/title action now surfaces immediately on .vi, .ctl, and .vit files instead of waiting for background eligibility indexing.
The generic bootstrap is implemented on the authority 1.2.0 line and the maintained public develop candidate that carried Sergio's first findings fold was published at e8b0925 through GitHub PR #15.
In a brand-new Codespace, the no-argument command now prompts for the public repo URL interactively and points users back to the canonical helper-backed sample when they cancel.
When --branch is omitted, the command resolves the remote default branch; when provided, the explicit branch is honored exactly.
Sergio dry-ran the maintained public wiki procedures from a brand new fork and a brand new Codespace and submitted findings that are now folded locally in authority.

A repo-access LLM pre-review then withdrew false blockers and left one smaller doc-clarification slice for the public README, install summary, supported-host wording, and compile troubleshooting language.
That clarification slice was then republished on maintained public develop head c9806c3 through GitHub PR #16 and on maintained public wiki head b30d356.

Sergio's next brand-new-fork review on hse-logger then found a real moved-VI compare blocker on selected/base pair 81325a7 -> 4a265f6 because comparison preflight and runtime staging still assumed the current workspace path on both sides.
The rename-aware compare fix was published on maintained public develop head fb46cbf through GitHub PR #17.

A follow-on maintained public refresh then published bundled compare-flow wording cleanup plus public-facade-linux-smoke required-check path-admission repair on develop head ac56456 through GitHub PR #18, while the maintained public wiki head remained b30d356.
The hosted proof is retained as public-surface evidence rather than canonical human acceptance.
The exact public baseline later advanced to v1.1.0 while this hosted proof remained the retained bootstrap evidence.
